categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-pressure hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic components (including pumps, valves, motors), hydraulic systems, and precision castings. The company serves industries such as construction machinery, industrial equipment, marine engineering, and new energy equipment. It also engages in research and development, production, and sales of related hydraulic products and systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced hydraulic technologies including high-pressure heavy-duty pumps, integrated power take-off units, servo hydraulic cylinders with low friction, and electronic pump drive systems with triple closed-loop control. Manufacturing involves precision casting, heat treatment with deformation control, and digital hydraulic multi-way valve technology. The company also invests in digitalization, electrification, and intelligent hydraulic solutions, including linear actuators and electro-hydraulic integrated motor-pump assemblies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international construction machinery manufacturers, especially excavator OEMs, industrial equipment producers, marine engineering firms, and new energy equipment manufacturers. The company has a strong presence in domestic markets and is expanding its footprint in overseas markets such as Europe, North America, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Major clients include Caterpillar, Sany, and XCMG.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major manufacturing facilities in Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Japan, the United States, Germany, Hong Kong, India, Mexico, Indonesia, France, Brazil, and Singapore, supporting a global sales and service network. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 22% of total revenue, reflecting ongoing international expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the hydraulic equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of hydraulic components and systems. It supplies critical hydraulic parts to OEMs and system integrators in heavy machinery and industrial sectors, positioning itself as a key component supplier and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-pressure hydraulic components, digital and electric hydraulic control systems, and intelligent servo technologies. It focuses on innovation to break foreign technology monopolies, develop integrated hydraulic solutions, and expand product applications across multiple industries. Strategic initiatives include global capacity expansion, electrification of hydraulic drives, and development of linear actuators to capture emerging market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of hydraulic cylinders, pumps, valves, motors, and integrated hydraulic systems. The company also earns income from after-sales services, technical support, and licensing of proprietary technologies. Government subsidies and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international hydraulic component manufacturers such as Rexroth, Kawasaki, Parker, and Danfoss, as well as Japanese firms like KYB in the excavator hydraulic cylinder segment. Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic positions itself as a leading domestic high-end hydraulic equipment supplier with growing international presence, focusing on technology leadership and brand reputation to compete globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenues of approximately RMB 9.39 billion, representing a 4.51% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.51 billion, showing stable growth. Total assets reached RMB 19.64 billion, up 9.74%, and shareholders' equity was RMB 15.77 billion, up 9.61%. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest heavily in capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic differentiates itself through advanced technology innovation, high product quality, and comprehensive service capabilities. It offers domestically developed high-pressure hydraulic components that meet or exceed international standards, breaking foreign monopolies in large-scale hydraulic cylinders. The company emphasizes integrated hydraulic solutions, digital and electric control technologies, and global localized service networks to provide superior value to customers in demanding industrial applications.
